caption: The drawing depicts a full-body image of a dark-skinned male figure standing barefoot on a light-colored, hexagonal pedestal. The figure is adorned with a blue turban featuring a red accent in the center and a white jewel, large gold hoop earrings, and a draped, golden-yellow cloth slung over the left shoulder and wrapped around the waist. The figure’s right hand grips the end of a large, brown club or staff that rests vertically on the ground, while the left arm is bent at the elbow so that the hand rests on the hip. The bodily form is muscular and proportionate, while facial features include prominent lips, a straight nose, and a focused expression. The background of the image is plain and uncolored, placing emphasis on the figure.
title: Slave Advertising Figure
